My favorite product management templates — 1-pagers, strategy, GTM, and more | 2020-08-04 | Tags: strategy, design, engineering, leadership, b2b, go-to-market
Q: I’ve seen you share a few PM templates in the past. Do you have a place to find all of your favorite templates?
✍️ 1-pagers/PRDs
1. [My personal 1-pager template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1541V32QgSwyCFWxtiMIThn-6n-2s7fVWztEWVa970uo/edit) —How I start every project
2. [Kevin Yien’s PRD template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mEMDcHmtQ6twzNlpvF-9maNlAcezpWDtCnyIqWkODZs/edit) (PM at Square)—Love this whole template, particularly the “Non-Goals” section and the step-by-step flow
3. [Asana’s project brief template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W46cmPfPwXIIH2mNNbbQ5EdjnhQFqGxGhT5iAijmJjc/edit#heading=h.cqt1a4hrfy8u) —Also love this whole template, particularly the problem statement framework
4. [Intercom’s story template](https://s3.amazonaws.com/marketing.intercomcdn.com/assets/Intercom-Job-Story-template.pdf) —Love the simplicity, while still having everything you need to get started
5. [Product Hunt’s PRD template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yrU5F6Gxhkfma91wf_IbZfexw8_fahbGQLW3EvwdfQI/edit) —Love the way it begins (Who, Why, What), though a bit long
6. [Adam Waxman’s PRD template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xc9TZX-7NMfOykzFKR0o0jzTUygoAFzWadxDVR7sNvs/edit?usp=sharing) (Design at SeatGeek)—Love 1-pager summary section before it dives deep
7. [Steve Morin’s 1-pager template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BeNK9BYd3-8pAqVYR_B0Gzp7kGNtWdPFHJKIXI52_84/edit?ts=5f264700#heading=h.6jynaot9cbnq) (EM at Asana)—Love the focus on success criteria and risks
8. [Figma’s PRD template](https://coda.io/@yuhki/figmas-approach-to-product-requirement-docs/prd-name-of-project-1) —A super-comprehensive plug-and-play template
9. [Adam Thomas’s initiative template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1B3GEUwgEIIQVgRp85l4DKLZOTzgGZmBIAjR06p4wuwY/edit#) —A reminder of how valuable it is to keep these to one page, at least to start

**Go-to-market**

👌
**Other templates**
1. [Roadmap template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zlx3RuidNOW40Zf7gh07p2SqoR53Ungv9JFT-PhHwxI/edit#gid=184965050)
2. [Performance review template](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SXO4eH8ZvpuONpdlxpu6y1ufDS0n6vbciV4IJzpm-sc/edit)
3. [Planning timeline template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1RTMr9vGCYEhWYA2dKG8EYLDFEtQ1E33W8uDEhmEd8QQ/edit?usp=drive_web&ouid=111613335789441259753)
🤤
**Additional goodness**
1. [Gokul’s S.P.A.D.E. decision-making framework](https://coda.io/@gokulrajaram/gokuls-spade-toolkit)
2. [How we make decisions at Coinbase](https://medium.com/@barmstrong/how-we-make-decisions-at-coinbase-cd6c630322e9)
3. [The Pyramid Principle](https://medium.com/lessons-from-mckinsey/the-pyramid-principle-f0885dd3c5c7)
4. [“Jobs to Be Done” framework](https://uxdesign.cc/8-things-to-use-in-jobs-to-be-done-framework-for-product-development-4ae7c6f3c30b)
5. [Eigenquestions: The Art of Framing Problems](https://coda.io/@shishir/eigenquestions-the-art-of-framing-problems/)
6. [We Don’t Sell Saddles Here](https://medium.com/@stewart/we-dont-sell-saddles-here-4c59524d650d)
7. [Business strategy concepts](https://sriramk.com/strategy)
8. [High Output Founders’ Library](https://www.notion.so/High-Output-Founders-Library-48742928f9f149b8a777e11a1409ce0a)

[shoot them over](https://twitter.com/lennysan)
. I’ll use this post as a living document of the best product development templates.
